title: Delaware Code, Title 19 (Labor), Chapter 19 — Delaware Workplace Adjustment and Retraining Notification Act
source_id: 19 Del. C. ch. 19 (cited in the text as the 'Delaware Worker Adjustment and Retraining Notification Act')
verified_how: fetched the register chapter page: heading 'CHAPTER 19. Delaware Workplace Adjustment and Retraining Notification Act', short-title provision reading 'This chapter shall be known and may be cited as the "Delaware Worker Adjustment and Retraining Notification Act"', session-law credit 81 Del. Laws, c. 312.
notes: Delaware's mini-WARN: notice of mass layoff, plant closing or relocation. Worth flagging that the chapter heading in the Code ('Workplace') differs from the short title in the text ('Worker'). Delaware is otherwise at-will and has no severance-pay entitlement.
